Align coverage and Node.js checks

Upgrade to c8 12 and use it for both text and HTML coverage reports. Match the regular test command, remove the duplicate Node.js coverage report, and exclude scripts, tests, and generated reports from coverage or linting as appropriate.

Declare the CommonJS package type and lint .mjs files with Node.js globals that exclude CommonJS-only bindings. Align ESLint configuration structure, Git ignore patterns, and LF line endings with the other jsdom projects.

Use ci.yml with the CI workflow name, multiline YAML lists, consistent job and step names, and read-only repository permissions. Enforce dependency engines in workflow installations and explicitly test Node.js 26.0.0 alongside the existing minimum versions.

Update to ESLint config 6.1.0 and regenerate the lockfile.
